misses.counterfactual_theory: An immutable record linking each forecast’s original specification, issuance time, eligible evidence cutoff, and subsequent realized outcome would make it possible to assess whether a forecast miss occurred. The supplied target-time prices alone cannot establish that.
misses.decision_reference: research/framework_memory/settlement_evidence/EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36.json and related settlement records provide target-time BTC/ETH prices; EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE explicitly state that forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs are missing.
misses.decision_relevance: Without the forecast and its timing provenance, target-time settlement prices cannot be compared with a decision available beforehand; no decision failure or portfolio result is demonstrated.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: Settlement records contain target-time prices, but the supplied evidence does not include the corresponding forecast specifications, issuance times, or eligible evidence cutoffs. A forecast miss cannot be established.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked realized outcomes are absent, preventing ex-ante alignment and miss assessment.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records report confirmed target-time mark prices, including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36 and other supplied EXP-FC records. These prices are not linked to an available prior forecast specification.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
